label: ADR-006: Unified Multi-Provider Ticket Engine and Canonical Issue Templates
ADR-008: Fail-closed enforcement: exit codes, signed measured receipts, authenticated workbench

metadata.decision: 1) The CLI exit status mirrors result.success; unknown commands exit 2; hooks rely on set -e. 2) Engine code never builds shell strings from filenames or refs; git/test invocations use execFileSync argv arrays, and a test bans execSync template literals with interpolation. 3) Gate receipts are issued only from values measured into the session manifest (coverage, mutation or explicit not-configured, recorded reviewer verdict, drift result) and are HMAC-SHA256 signed with a local key (.agent/.receipt-key, gitignored) or SDLC_RECEIPT_KEY; the ledger is described as a hash chain, not a Merkle tree. 4) Missing or stale coverage/mutation reports fail the gate and are never cached; gate parses coverage against thresholds. 5) The workbench binds 127.0.0.1, requires a per-run random token for every request, accepts only same-origin Origin/Host, and is no longer auto-spawned.
